title: KGHaluBench: A Knowledge Graph-Based Hallucination Benchmark for Evaluating the Breadth and Depth of LLM Knowledge

bias_targets.methodology: Estimating question difficulty by aggregating entity statistics (e.g., page views, site links, Wikipedia token count) and relation complexity, then applying a difficulty-based scaling to the evaluation metric (Weighted Accuracy, Wa) to ensure LLMs are assessed fairly across both well-known and obscure entities.
